content: Nkweel a Zyak anà nköör a Petↄlà
Yàmԑnà naa utaaŋ alan, mfum Ɛlↄdi kàsԑmà mumԑɛy baar a Ikööŋ bàmwɛy nkwaaŋ.
Nde kàdwä Zyak, un'tↄŋ a Ywan wàbaal, a kↄm.
Mpal kàmԑn nde naa ya yan'pà Ayudà un'sak, nde kàfàkɔr Petↄlà ilä a mampà ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ful.
Ungö mukun'kɔr, nde kun'tↄↄm u bɔlokà, kun'pԑ kan'kↄↄ a itsuŋ inà bye abyà aŋità anà uboo a imwɛy ntɔn mukun'kaar. Nde kàkwen mukun'sà u làbay a nsaŋ u mii a un'sɛŋ ungö mukyɛɛl Pak.
Petↄlà bun'käär u bↄlokà. Wԑԑ Ikööŋ kyàyɔ̈n anki musà ngyamàkà akà Nzam ntↄn nde.
Ntsuuŋ a Petↄlà
Wԑԑ u mpib, kusà a ilä kàbön Ɛlↄdi mutsul nsaŋ ande u mii a un'sɛŋ, Petↄlà kàkäl wàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n uboboo a aŋità abɔ̈ɔ̈l, wàŋàbääm an'dwaaŋ mɔ̈ɔ̈l. Aseey a bↄlokà bàkäl u munàmbwo.

Wԑԑ kà imbürà, un'kyeey a Mwol mwԑy waa kàyàmԑnà, bↄlokà waa làpԑԑlà. Un'kyeey kàni Petɔlà u làbɛm, kun'wiiy, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mbarà agyägyä! » Apan, an'dwaaŋ màkäl kà an'kↄↄ ande waa màbü.
Un'kyeey kàtɛn a nde naa: « Bäm un'kab angye, bwaar idyäär angye. » Nde waa kàkyer abun. Nde kàfàtɛn a nde naa: « Bwaar ipfɛy angye, yan'läb. »
Nde kàkyer atoo, waa kun'läb. Wԑԑ nde kàyöb anki naa ndaa kàkyerà un'kyeey yàkäl ndandaa. Nde kàsii naa kya kyà imanmii.

Apan ba bàlyaaŋ ikal a nseey kyàtàtwԑb, bàfàlyaaŋ kyàyweel, waa bàtöl u munàmbwo awe anà ibeenà a in'naan ifàler mper a bul. Ibeenà aki kyàdubà kya ŋakwo kusà a ba. Ba waa bàtoo, bàyikyeenà u balàbal làmwey. Apan, un'kyeey kàsun'wɛy kà imbürà.
Mpal màfurà an'kyän a Petↄlà, nde kàtԑn naa: « Apanà mԑ an'yöb naa ndandaa Mwol kàtöm un'kyeey ande, nde kàman'tsuuŋ kà an'kↄↄ a Ɛlↄdi anà akà yinà yanswà kàdiilà un'sԑŋ a Ayudà. »
Ungö kàyöb nde abun, nde kàkyen ndwà a Màlye, ngwän a Ywan awà bàfàbel Malakↄ. Akun, baar mbɔɔn bàkyer aköŋ anà bàkäl muyamà.
Mpal kàbԑԑrà nde kà ibeenà a munàmbwo, un'syääl mwɛy wà un'kaar ikↄb ande Lↄdԑ waa kàsin muwem.
Nde kàyöb ndaa a Petↄlà. Wԑԑ unsà un'sak ande, nde kàduub anki ndwà, nde kàkyen u ntiin ntↄn mukàkyään naa Petↄlà wàŋàmbar u nsà.
Wԑԑ ba bàtԑn a nde naa: « Ngye awe anà nukↄŋ. » Wԑԑ nde kàsi muküünà mutɛn naa yà ndandaa. Apan, ba bàtɛn naa: « Un'kyeey ande ayàkal. »
Wԑԑ Petↄlà kàsi muküünà mubԑԑrà. Ba bàduub ndwà, waa bàbem mpal bun'mɛn ba.

Wɛɛ akà nde, nde kadübà mun a kↄↄ ntɔn mukaswaŋ naa ba bàkäl a duu, nde kakyään naa Mwol kàkyer aben mukun'twey u nsà a bↄlokà. Nde kàtԑn sye naa: « Kyen kàlakyään Zyak anà atↄŋ bumwԑy indiir abi. » Apan, nde waa kàtoo, kàkyen mper asin.
Wԑԑ mpal làtyà taaŋ, lingyoomà làbü uboo a aŋità, ba bàtԑn ba a ba naa Petↄlà nkye byàmubweel?
Ɛlↄdi kàkäl muyun'leŋ, wԑԑ nde kun'mɛn anki. Nde kàfuul aleer, waa kàswɛŋ naa basyen anà badwä. Ungö nde kàlwomà u Yuday, waa kàtyà Sԑzarԑ. Nde kàkäl ndam a ilä kwo.
Nkweel a Ɛlↄdi

Ɛlↄdi kàkäl nkyԑl mbↄↄn akà baar a Tir anà Sidↄn. Wԑԑ ba bàkäl un'tüüb mwԑy ntↄn mukun'man. An'yääm a ba anà Balàstüs, mbuur kàfaleerà suk a mfum, màkyer abwaŋ. Ungö ba bàkàlɔm mfum Ɛlↄdi musà duu uboo a ba, ntↄn udyà aba bàfafaa nsi a mfum Ɛlↄdi.
Mpal kyàkwe ilä bàsi ba, Ɛlↄdi kàbwäär ipfԑy a imfum, laa kàbwaay de kà un'syäl, waa kàtɛɛnà a ba u mii a un'sԑŋ.
Apan, un'sԑŋ kàtԑn u ndaa a ngwal naa: « Ayi ntɛɛn a nzam mwɛy, wԑԑ kà yà mbuur anki. »
Wԑԑ utaaŋ nsil alan, un'kyeey a Mwol waa kun'düb, ntↄn nde Nzam làkoo kun'pԑ anki. In'swab myàkyer un'dyà, laa kàkü nde.
Apan, Ndaa a Nzam waa yàyԑl, waa yàpää.
Wԑԑ akà Banabasi anà Sↄl, mpal bàmay ba isal aba u Yԑlusàlԑm, ba bàkyer akyà, waa bàsyen anà Ywan awà bàfàbel Malakↄ.
